name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI models run faster on everyday computer chips instead of needing expensive specialized hardware.
buyer: A hardware/device maker who wants to run AI features on cheaper chips without a cloud GPU bill, e.g. a smart-camera or kiosk manufacturer.
business_use_cases: A smart-camera startup runs object detection on-device using OpenVINO instead of paying for cloud inference per frame.
A retail kiosk vendor adds on-device AI features (recognition, recommendations) without needing a GPU server.
An edge-AI consultancy optimizes client models with OpenVINO to cut their cloud inference costs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'cut your AI cloud bill' optimization consulting for companies running inference at scale.

steal_this: This is a dev-tool, not a consumer product — the real opportunity is offering inference-cost-reduction consulting to companies, not building on it as a standalone product this weekend.
